newsitem.title: USA: Golf-Appleby maintains hot run of form.
newsitem.headline: Golf-Appleby maintains hot run of form.

text.p: Australian golfer Stuart Appleby has maintained his excellent form on the U.S. PGA Tour with a second place finish at the Bay Hill Invitational.
Appleby, the surprise winner of last week's Honda Classic, finished three shots behind American Phil Mickelson in the Florida event.
The Australian, who has qualified for next month's U.S. Masters at Augusta on the strength of his Honda win, fired a final round 69 for an aggregate score of 275, 13 under par.
Mickelson came from two shots off the pace overnight to pull clear of the field with a seven under par round of 65.
